items.title: Live: PM confirms two military planes deployed to Middle East, Israel launches strikes on Tehran
items.description: PM confirms two military assets have been deployed to Middle East to help stranded Australians.

items.title: Maps and photos show the Iran war has seeped into the wider Middle East
items.description: Hundreds of people have been killed as the war being waged by the US and Israel on Iran has spread across the Middle East as humanitarian bodies warn of the impact on civilians.

items.title: Iranian diaspora in Australia react to a shattered homeland
items.description: As US-Israeli strikes shake Iran, the Iranian diaspora describe a turbulent mix of relief, grief and helplessness as they wait for news from loved ones and are met with silence.

items.title: How does power work inside Iran?
items.description: The most powerful man in Iran has been killed.  So why is the war still continuing and why hasn’t the regime collapsed? Iran is a theocracy and the entire system has been set up to survive both external and internal threats. The supreme leader commands the armed forces, influences the courts, and has the final say on all major decisions. Let's take a closer look at how power is structured inside Iran.

items.title: Canadian PM Mark Carney and Albanese brush off calls for Middle East ceasefire
items.description: Anthony Albanese and Mark Carney stop short of calling for a ceasefire in the Middle East as the war widens, with Iran launching missiles at Türkiye and a United States submarine sinking an Iranian navy vessel off Sri Lanka.

items.title: Wilson croons, Taylor gets politicking and Carney visits
items.description: This week in Canberra, Tim Wilson did his best Billy Joel impression, the opposition leader went hard on the government over the cost-of-living crisis and the Canadian prime minister popped into parliament.

items.title: 'From the river to the sea' and 'globalise the intifada' banned in Qld
items.description: Sweeping new hate speech laws banning certain expressions in a way that makes a member of the public feel menaced, harassed or offended have passed in Queensland parliament.

items.title: 'Rare leader': Tributes flow in following retirement of Pat Turner
items.description: Indigenous trailblazer Pat Turner has announced her retirement after a "tireless" career dedicated to championing the rights of First Nations people.

items.title: Live: Matildas seek spot in Asian Cup quarterfinals against Iran
items.description: The Matildas face Iran at Robina, seeking a win to secure a spot in the knockout stages of the Women's Asian Cup. Follow live.

items.title: Live: 'I know what I would do': Voss's request to Blues ahead of Curnow meeting
items.description: Charlie Curnow faces his old teammates in his very first match representing the Sydney Swans as Carlton comes to town for the AFL's season-opener. Follow live.

items.title: Live: Storm and Eels in round one meet after offseason drama between clubs
items.description: The Melbourne Storm host the Parramatta Eels in round one, after both clubs were central to one of the biggest dramas this offseason. Follow live.

items.title: Aston Martin drivers 'risk permanent nerve damage' driving for too long
items.description: Aston Martin will almost certainly not finish this weekend's Formula 1 Australian Grand Prix, if it even starts at all, over fears the vibration of the car could permanently injure its drivers.

items.title: 'About to have them taken away': Qld weighs up under-16 e-bike, scooter ban
items.description: The Queensland government says it will quickly consider a raft of recommendations aimed at tightening laws around the use of e-bikes and e-scooters, including banning the devices for under-16s.

items.title: Decorated youth camp founder found guilty of child sex abuse
items.description: A jury returns majority guilty verdicts in the trial of Geoff Guest, 99, who has an Order of Australia Medal for his youth work.

items.title: The latest viral health food trend claims to lower your BMI
items.description: Black sesame is the latest plant-based product to go viral with social media claiming these seeds reduce blood sugar, risk of heart disease and can even reverse grey hair.

items.title: From emotional buys to bad bones: Avoid these traps when looking for a house
items.description: In the market for a ready-to-renovate property? Here are some tips to help you uncover a gem, from Grand Designs Transformations host Anthony Burke — and a couple who just did it with little DIY experience.

items.title: ABC Places quiz: Where in the world is this?
items.description: Today's ABC Places quiz features photos from 10 locations around the world. Your challenge is to guess where you are.

items.title: Parents are 'following the money' in rush to private schools, experts warn
items.description: The latest schools data from the Australian Bureau of Statistics shows a tinderbox of problems that experts warn could explode with growing pressure on household budgets.

items.title: Chinese nationals found huddled near High Country hut died of hypothermia
items.description: A coroner has determined that two Chinese students found dead while hiking in the High Country died from hypothermia.

items.title: Shark attack off Qld island leaves snorkeller wounded
items.description: A man in his 50s has wounds to his arm, abdomen and hand after a shark attack on the Southern Great Barrier Reef.

items.title: Compulsory land acquisition amendments leave farmers 'gutted'
items.description: Farmers are left gutted after the Victorian government passes new amendments allowing transmission companies to compulsorily acquire land.

items.title: Star's former CEO and lawyer facing millions in fines over Chinese money laundering case
items.description: Star casino's former top boss and its legal counsel both breached their director's duties and "failed" to heed warnings about money laundering by Chinese criminal syndicates, the Federal Court in Sydney has found.

items.title: NT hit-and-run driver who called victims 'dogs' allowed to keep licence
items.description: A driver who hit two pedestrians in Darwin, one of whom died, fled the scene and then boasted about the crash to friends has been allowed to keep his driver’s licence.

items.title: SA woman charged with criminal neglect after baby's death
items.description: A woman has been arrested and charged with criminal neglect after the death of a nine-month-old baby boy, police say.

items.title: Runaway truck loaded with bricks ploughs into parked cars
items.description: The driver has been praised for his quick-thinking as the out-of-control truck hurtled down the hill.
